sloka: मनोहर स्निग्ध वर्णो रत्नैः नाना विधैः वृतः ।क्षणेन राक्षसो जातो मृगः परम शोभनः ॥३-४२-१९॥
transliteration: manohara snigdha varṇo ratnaiḥ nānā vidhaiḥ vṛtaḥ ।kṣaṇena rākṣaso jāto mṛgaḥ parama śobhanaḥ ॥3-42-19॥

translations.english: Transformed into a most beautiful deer in a moment, Maricha brightened the beautiful forest and Rama's hermitage.
